sources.snippet: A deep generative model is a generative model in which either pθ(x) or pθ(x|y) are represented by (deep) neural networks (with parameters θ)! To be more concrete, a deep generative model is a neural network that allows us to sample x from the distribution pθ(x) (or pθ(x|y)).
